result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on second-order linear PDEs in two variables (alpha, beta), seeking solutions linear in alpha (u = (db/dbeta) alpha + b) for a heat-conduction-type equation, plus notes on the heat equation in three dimensions with exponential time dependence and gradient conditions.
